text:
elena: Morning — quick run through for Tue 10:00am PST candidate (final loop). Panel confirmed but need scribe + debrief owner. also want to lock rubric and time splits.

samir: I can scribe this one. will join 10 min early.

priya: I can own the debrief. can we use the same rubric as last round? (link pasted to doc)

jordan: +1 on rubric. tiny ask: are we doing 50m design + 10m discussion or 45/15?

elena: prefer 50/10 to keep consistency with scheduler. rubric weights i propose: tech=60 / product=25 / communication=15. please ack.

priya: ack to weights.

samir: ack. calendar invite has Zoom; can someone share candidate test account creds?

elena: shared in 1Password item "candidate-final-zoom" and added short checklist in the invite: 
- join 10 min early
- scribe captures top 3 signals + red flags
- quick scores posted in this thread after call (one-line per panel)

people-ops-bot: Reminder: interview debriefs must be submitted within 48h of the interview. :bell:

jordan: quick clarification on scoring: if a panelist misses >1 section (e.g., had to drop early), do we prorate or escalate?

priya: option: scribe marks sections as "partial" and we prorate for a single miss. if >1 missing or a conflict, escalate to hiring lead and we schedule a short make-up.

samir: noted. will mark partial if needed. pinging @talent for backup if candidate requests reschedule.

talent: available for last-minute swaps today until 3pm PDT — can step in as scribe or panel if needed.

elena: perfect. final assignment: scribe = samir, debrief owner = priya, timeslot locked. thanks everyone — rolling this to the calendar. :thumbsup:
